post.description: Creates an exam in DRAFT status. Only teachers and admins may create exams.

delete.description: Soft-deletes an exam. Only exams without active student sessions or assignments can be deleted; active exams must be archived.

patch.description: Updates title, description, or duration. Only draft exams can be structurally modified. Published exams only permit non-structural changes.

put.description: Updates title, description, or duration. Only draft exams can be modified by their creator.

post.description: Transitions an exam to ARCHIVED status. Archived exams are immutable.
Transitions an exam from DRAFT to PUBLISHED status, freezing all structural fields.

get.description: Returns questions. Students receive masked options (is_correct omitted), while teachers see complete option details.

post.description: Only allowed for draft exams by the creator.
post.summary: Add a question to an exam

post.description: Reverts an exam from PUBLISHED to DRAFT status if no active assignments or student sessions exist.

200.description: Exam unpublished successfully and reverted to DRAFT

put.description: Updates question text, points, or number. Only allowed when the exam is in DRAFT status.

post.summary: Add an option to an MCQ question

post.description: Starts an exam session for an assigned student. Only 1 active session allowed per assignment.
